label: Thirteen-slot profile schema: targeted admissibility and same-bearer GOD_4 naming (#1864)
summary: Follow-on to merged #1865, in the Lean module TruthCore/Modal/DivineProfile.lean (moved out of ActualistDomains in repair pass 1). ProfileSlots is a 13-slot world-indexed predicate schema with NO sense fixed: every theorem quantifies over an arbitrary schema and holds with every slot True (Control.noSenseFixed); the slots are not StageTwo's typed senses nor NamingVeracityBatch1.Power, because those are world-invariant and IsTheOneGod/GodIsOmnipotent use sigma.IsGod, which must stay out of possible-world premises. ExcellenceAt asks all thirteen slots of one bearer at one world; GreatnessAt reuses #1865's MaximalProfile over M = m.frame. Proved (zero axioms): described_greatness_transfer, a near-transcription (one application of the profile-specific AdmitGreatnessWorlds; singleton case of #438 TransferLaws); greatness_at_origin from EuclideanAt and ActualReflexive at w only (same algorithm as ActualEuclidean.necessaryAtOrigin; new content is the excellence conjunct), factored through the witness-relative condition M(v,w) and M(w,u) -> M(v,u), which needs no reflexivity; describedInnerE_to_outerE with the extra InnerSuccessorsCovered bridge, since DescribedPossibleGreatness is outer-E/inner-M and therefore not purely descriptive; profileNineSuffice_of_senseBridges, deriving the distinct analyst bridge ProfileNineSuffice (not STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE) from the canonical typed StageTwo instance plus explicit actual-world sense bridges ProfileToStageTwoSenses, with a one slot meant to be GOD-free (an instantiation rule the type does not enforce; a registration must check that no slot mentions IsGod) bridged to IsTheOneGod only at w; actual_named_classical_god/actual_god_exists from these plus the OPEN ActualDivineNaming; actual_necessary_bundle_greatness, showing that an actual excellent bearer plus NecessaryExcellenceAt (necessary existence and excellence, not essentiality) already gives the actual maximal profile with no frame condition, so the possibility detour adds no independent support. Finite controls: E-witness without M-witness; targeted admissibility without global inclusion; separately instantiated power/knowledge without joint bearer; K5 Euclidean without actual existence (Euclidean alone insufficient); Euclidean-at-w without reflexivity still returning the profile (reflexivity not necessary); inner-E without outer-E; slot separations (good without morallyPerfect, intellect without omniscient, will without free); naming omission (every other premise of actual_god_exists true, IsGod empty, GodExists false). Positive warrant: the actual same-root/esse/perfection/intellect-will corpus bears on the actual-bearer input once slots receive fixed senses; it does not yet give power, full knowledge, moral perfection or freedom in any fixed sense. Best supported incompatibility pressure remains #555's necessary strict-efficacy same-act with a contingent effect, applicable only under a definite simplicity/freedom reading. No canonical argument/result registered; no root premise change. Continuation (2026-11-23): a fixed GOD-free instance now reuses StageTwo IsSimple/IsPerfect/IsSupremelyGood/IsImmutable, selected-root uniqueness, existing capacity Intellect/Will, DeiFiliusAttributeField.IsAlmighty, and explicit world-indexed content-knowledge/permitted-selection/noncoerced-choice candidate senses. positiveCore_from_same_root reuses NecessaryPositiveRootIntellectWillAt for one witness with necessity and six typed attributes (conditional on its full original inputs). fixed_to_stageTwo_senses derives eight pointwise slot bridges and isolates the ninth as open actual-world selected-root-to-IsTheOneGod naming. Two formal intersection discriminators: factive complete knowledge plus rigidly invariant known-content extension precludes contingent truth across worlds; power for a coherent forbidden task and impeccability of actual selection jointly entail capability without selection, not contradiction. All are Lean-only proposed results pending final-head CI and independent semantic challenge; no metaphysical possibility or GOD_4 bridge established. Follow-on same-witness positive extension: positiveCore_with_infinite_power_from_same_root applies existing SubsistentBeingIsInfiniteReading to the n with esse=essence in NecessaryPositiveRootIntellectWillAt, then reuses registered infinitePowerFromAct under OPEN InfiniteIsUnlimitedAct, ActivePowerFollowsAct and ConsistentTaskRequiresOnlyPossiblePerfections. This reaches eight fixed candidate slots (adding infinite and omnipotent capacity) on the same necessary actual source without introducing IsGod or altering the source premises; no actual creation or cognition follows. Continuation of #1880: immutable_eternal_of_simple_act derives absence of passive potency and q.10 eternity from actual esse, simple subject, the existing ActAndPotencyMakeComposite premise and ImmutableIsEternalReading. positiveCore_with_ten_from_same_root reuses the earlier eight-slot route, identifies its witness with the originally unique selected root, and carries ten fixed candidate slots on that SAME actual bearer. All root, infinity, power, act/potency composition and eternity premises remain OPEN; there is no conversion to necessary full divine possibility. New positive/negative power-morality discriminator: if moral impeccability means INCAPACITY to do forbidden acts, IsAlmighty forces all forbidden mapped tasks to be logically inconsistent; a coherently defined forbidden mapped task makes that stronger bundle inconsistent. Impeccable nonselection does not entail inability. This is selected-sense conditional research, not a real contradiction in theism. Restored-commitment finite control on the EXISTING alternatingEffects universe: the same necessary source has no passive potency and is simple and eternal; one ACTUAL effect is nonvacuously composite and passively potent; actual-world esse dictionary matches its inventory. The source has changing complete-factive extensional content knowledge across the alternatives and selects distinct permitted noncoerced options whose output correlation tracks existing world-relative causal effects. Existing contingent first effect and no-fixed-effect theorem hold. Crucially no intrinsic cognitively grounded uptake, causally effective intentional choice, God naming, full 13-slot profile or M-admissibility are represented, and neither is inferred. Semantic-challenge repair of 9d5384c3: nine fixedProfile slots (simple, perfect, good, infinite, immutable, eternal, intellect, will, omnipotent) ignore the world argument, so they are rigid BY CONSTRUCTION (fixedProfile_rigid, definitional): an encoded interpretive commitment, not derived essentiality, adding no evidence for M-necessary excellence; the open cross-world gap for this profile is one, omniscient, morallyPerfect and free. The ten-slot theorem now takes the registered weaker ActInBeingAndPotencyMakeComposite (d8024a38) instead of the unrestricted 3d99779b; prior art 379399d1 already derives pure actuality and eternity on the same route, so the ten-slot theorem adds the GOD-free packaging and omnipotence only. The CreationControl's single forbidden option is outside Capable (checked conjunct), so it shows nonselection by incapacity, not able-but-never-chooses. The primitives Knows, Chooses, Permitted, Capable, Imposed and the candidate senses KNOW, MORALLY_PERFECT, FREE have no DEF records and need them before any registration; nothing yet separates Knows as uptake from a truth oracle. C5 continuation (2026-11-23, PR #1890): the actual-source completion test of C5/¬C5 and its own scoped current assessment are recorded in attempt 7c159d8e; this attempt's #1880-scope assessment is unchanged.
blocker: Still OPEN: full traditional same-source omniscience (intrinsic actual intentional uptake and content coverage), morally perfect rational choice, timeless free creative willing, and necessary excellence across M; concrete application of #555 strict same-act efficacy to selected simple source; M's metaphysical interpretation and admission of the exact full profile; actualist/counterpart identity and actual-world GOD_4 naming; DEF/disambiguation/bound corpus edge before any STMT-GOD-EXISTS registration. The ten-slot source route additionally depends on the act-in-esse/potency composition premise d8024a38 and the immutable=>eternal bridge. Nine fixedProfile slots are rigid only by construction; a warrant for that rigidity (essentiality across M) is missing. DEF records for Knows/Chooses/Permitted/Capable/Imposed and the KNOW, MORALLY_PERFECT and FREE senses are missing. The targeted re-check of the repairs to the independent semantic challenge of 9d5384c3 confirmed them at 2cb64870. The C5/¬C5 blocker is recorded in attempt 7c159d8e.

current_assessment.assessment: Conditional development beyond merged #1876; independent semantic challenge of 9d5384c3 requested changes (F1 P1, seven P2), repaired. Under the COMPLETE existing NecessaryPositiveRootIntellectWillAt premise bundle plus Aquinas q.7 essence–esse->infinity, three explicit q.25 task-power premises, the registered weaker ActInBeingAndPotencyMakeComposite (d8024a38) and ImmutableIsEternalReading, the SAME existing necessary actual source has ten selected fixed predicate slots: simple, perfect, causal/ontologically good, unique selected root, infinite, intellect capacity, will capacity, unlimited coherent-task power, no passive potency and eternal. Relative to registered argument 379399d1, which already derives pure actuality and eternity on this route, the new content is the GOD-free packaging and omnipotence. This is not the full traditional divine profile. Nine of the ten slots (all but one) are world-free in fixedProfile and so hold at every world by construction (fixedProfile_rigid): that is an encoded interpretive commitment, not derived essentiality, and it adds no evidence for M-necessary excellence; the genuinely open cross-world gap for this profile is one, omniscient, morallyPerfect and free. The three remaining full-profile slots—intrinsic omniscient knowledge, moral perfection and free willing—are not supplied, and the selected proxy interpretations of each are weaker than the claims sought. A stronger moral incapacity reading plus omnipotence requires forbidden mapped tasks to be inconsistent; on an independently coherent forbidden task that bundle fails. A weaker impeccable nonselection reading avoids that conflict, without settling divine goodness. Neither mathematical satisfiability nor lack of discovered contradiction establishes real M-admissibility; full GOD_4 naming remains separate. An added model on #462's SAME frame restores simple/potency-free source and nonvacuous composite/potent creature, with world-indexed truth-complete extensional knowledge and selected permissible alternative outputs; it tests only non-entailment of content-invariance or fixed particular creation from these structural premises, NOT genuine metaphysical possibility or actual intentional understanding. Its forbidden option is outside Capable, so it shows nonselection by incapacity, not able-but-never-chooses. The new primitives and the KNOW, MORALLY_PERFECT and FREE candidate senses need DEF records before any registration.
